meta.title: Rundberg Laundry — Pickup & Delivery Partner Program
meta.description: Build a pickup-and-delivery laundry business in Central Austin. You own the customers and set your own fees; Rundberg Laundry does the wash-dry-fold on commercial Electrolux 450G equipment with Omni UV water purification, processes payments, and pays you by check. No middle-man.
meta.ogTitle: Become a Rundberg Laundry pickup & delivery partner

hero.kicker: Central Austin · Pickup & Delivery Partner Program
hero.srTitle: Build a pickup-and-delivery laundry business — we do the washing.
hero.title: Build a pickup-and-delivery laundry business. We do the washing.
hero.sub: You own the customers, set your own prices, and run the routes. We wash, dry, and fold on commercial equipment, process the payments, and mail you a check. No middle-man.

steps.title: How the partnership works
steps.sub: Start to finish — from the bags in your hand to the check in your mailbox.
steps.s1b: We hand you durable laundry bags, each printed with its own QR code. No machines to buy, no plant to build.
steps.s2b: Tell us your pickup windows, delivery notes, and the area you serve. Your customers, your terms.
steps.s3b: Your customer scans the QR on their bag and signs up in under a minute. The bag is theirs — the relationship is yours.
steps.s4b: Collect full bags from your customers and bring them to our plant. You own the route and every customer on it.
steps.s5b: One flat per-order service rate covers the wash — you handle your customers, we handle the laundry.
steps.s6b: We process your customers' payments and mail you a check. No invoicing, no chasing money, no middle-man taking a cut.

plant.title: WE WASH IT RIGHT
plant.body: Every order is washed, dried, and folded at our Central Austin plant — so you never touch a machine. You build the business; we run the wash floor.
plant.spec1b: Electrolux CompassPro 450G high-extract washers — fast cycles, professional results, real throughput.
plant.spec2b: Hospital-grade UV treats the water itself — 99.9% of pathogens gone before the water ever touches a garment.
plant.spec3b: Consistent folding, fast turnaround, and capacity that scales with your route — no contracts, no setup fees.

why.title: Why partner with us
why.sub: A real business you own — not a gig that owns you.
why.p1b: The customer registers to you, not to us. Your list, your brand, your repeat business.
why.p2b: You pay one simple, flat per-order rate for the wash-dry-fold. No tiers, no minimums, no surprises.
why.p3b: No washers, no dryers, no lease, no plant. Start with a stack of bags and a vehicle.
why.p4b: Customer payments and your payouts run through us. You get a check — no merchant account, no collections.

who.title: Built for route-builders
who.p1b: Add wash-dry-fold pickup & delivery without adding a single machine.
who.p2b: Towels and member laundry, picked up and returned clean — on your schedule.
who.p3b: Turn units and refresh linens faster, with one partner handling the wash.
who.p4b: Build a delivery book from scratch with low overhead and no equipment risk.
